levels.title: Basic (11 terms)
levels.description: The 11 Berlin–Kay basic color terms. Every answer whose head word is a basic term counts for it (e.g. 'dark green', 'bluish green' and 'lime green' all count as green).

levels.title: Standard (28 names)
levels.description: The 36 most frequently given names (each given at least 13,559 times) plus the basic terms black and white — 38 candidates, 28 of which win somewhere. Comparable to xkcd's 2D map.

levels.title: Detailed (39 names)
levels.description: Every name given at least 1,504 times (179 candidates) competes; 39 of them are the most popular name somewhere in the cube.
